statement: ((List.range 8).map (fun t => if t >= 5 + t then 1 else 0) = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]) ∧ ((List.range 8).map (fun t => if 3 * t >= 5 + t then 1 else 0) = [0,0,0,1,1,1,1,1]) ∧ ((List.range 8).map (fun t => if t >= 5 + t then 1 else 0) ≠ (List.range 8).map (fun t => if 3 * t >= 5 + t then 1 else 0))
